decision_rule.summary: Accept the duration-record label only when the WMO storm-status duration exceeds John's duration benchmark; use distance, wind, rain/weather, and image/receptor rows as computed context.

ledger_rows.formula: sum local rain; count wet hours; maximize 72-hour rain; compare gridded rain, gust, and pressure range
retain image-change, radar-change, receptor-count, and image-size values as context only

primary_gt.canonical_stance: WMO duration gives the record proof: 36.0 d exceeds John by 6.25 d; distance ratio is 0.972, so distance does not set the record.
forbidden: local rain or image/receptor values as the record basis
exact loss claims from receptor or image metrics

provenance.notes: Computed from local CSX-125 records only; no network access is used.

criteria.description: Returns duration_record_status, all five named ledger rows, correct row roles, and one concise proof_conclusion.
criteria.name: Requested ledger structure
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly complete JSON object with one missing row or one role error.

criteria.description: Computes 36.0 WMO days, 33.75 GDACS days, the 2.25-day gap, 29.75 previous John days, the 6.25-day advantage, and the 1.21 duration ratio within tolerance.
criteria.name: Duration record arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-4 points for correct direction but one or two missing or rounded values; award 1 point for identifying duration as decisive without the arithmetic.

criteria.description: Computes 12,785 km versus 13,159 km, the 0.972 distance ratio, and the 0.319 Earth-circumference fraction, with distance below the previous benchmark.
criteria.name: Track-distance check
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct distances or correct ratio but incomplete conclusion.

criteria.description: Uses 250.0 km/h, Red alert, the 2.101 hurricane-threshold ratio, and the 173608.9 wind-energy proxy as intensity context rather than the record basis.
criteria.name: Wind energy context
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct wind values but a weak or missing role assignment.

criteria.description: Uses 375.2 mm, 425 wet hours, 111.7 mm max 72-hour rain, 46.918 mm CHIRPS event-accumulated gridded mean, 192.2 mm gridded maximum, 65.9 km/h gust, and 11.4 hPa pressure range as context.
criteria.name: Rain and weather context
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for most values correct but one aggregation or unit error.

criteria.description: Reports 0.0146 embedding mean change, 0.172 dB radar mean change, 14.572 dB radar absolute extreme, 5,286,729.5 compact-region population, and both image byte counts as context only.
criteria.name: Image and receptor context
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for reporting the values but making the role unclear.

criteria.description: Keeps the final proof concise and avoids extra realized-loss claims beyond the computed values.
criteria.name: Concise no-overclaim proof
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct conclusion with unnecessary but non-conflicting prose.
